key.name: preview-mode
key.description: Report the changes 'Organize Selection' would make instead of moving anything. The report is written next to the log file and opened when the run finishes.

key.name: cleanup-enabled
key.description: Move the non-music files sitting beside a track, such as artwork and text files, to wherever the track is moved.

key.name: cleanup-empty-folders
key.description: Delete the folder a track came from once it is empty, and any empty parents up to but never including the library location.

key.name: strip-ntfs
key.description: Remove the characters Windows does not allow in a filename, and trailing full stops, when building paths.

key.name: log-enabled
key.description: Record every file operation to the log file.

key.name: log-path
key.description: An absolute path, or a name resolved against your home folder. Under Flatpak, where the home folder is not writable, a relative name is resolved against the application's own data directory instead.
